question: Should this visibility-only fix merge with a default doctor --lint warning for active skill shadowing, while leaving fail-closed denyShadowing policy out of this PR?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proven, but the new default lint warning can affect existing intentional override workflows and the linked issue includes a separate fail-closed policy proposal.

options.title: Approve visibility-only warning
options.body: Merge this PR after confirming that default warning/nonzero lint behavior for active shadowing is the desired compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Make lint opt-in first
options.body: Keep loader, CLI, status, and UI shadow visibility, but make the doctor warning opt-in or default-disabled until the upgrade impact is settled.

options.title: Hold for deny-shadowing policy
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers decide the fail-closed config shape and whether the linked issue should close without that capability.

recommendation.title: Approve visibility-only warning
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after confirming that default warning/nonzero lint behavior for active shadowing is the desired compatibility tradeoff.
